name: Hotel Post
beschreibung: Hotel Post in Kaltenbach in the Zillertal Valley is a historic inn with a long-standing tradition of warm Tyrolean hospitality. The interiors feature classic alpine woodwork creating a welcoming, cozy environment. Guests benefit from exceptional proximity to the premier Hochzillertal-Hochfügen ski resort and extensive summer hiking trails. Facilities include a relaxing wellness area with sauna and a restaurant serving regional half-board meals.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Post in Kaltenbach in the Zillertal Valley provides authentic Tyrolean hospitality, a sauna wellness area, traditional half-board dining, and quick access to Hochzillertal.
